description: This file contains unit tests for the PolicyCommandEnforcement component within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests various scenarios of policy command enforcement including create, modify, and retrieve policies, checking permissions, cache invalidation, and handling policy lockouts.

classes.name: PolicyCommandEnforcementTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the PolicyCommandEnforcement component in various scenarios, including permission checks, cache invalidation, and handling of policy lockout conditions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the actor system, probes, cache, and enforcer actor before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test.

methods.name: createPoliciesShardRegionProbe
methods.description: Creates a new TestProbe for simulating the policies shard region.

methods.name: createEnforcer
methods.description: Creates and returns an ActorRef representing the enforcer actor under test.

methods.name: createUniqueName
methods.description: Generates a unique actor name with the specified prefix.

methods.name: createCache
methods.description: Creates a Caffeine cache with the specified loader.

methods.name: assertRetrievePolicyResponse
methods.description: Asserts that the actual RetrievePolicyResponse matches the expected, checking entity ID, headers, and JSON content.

methods.name: createDefaultPolicyResponse
methods.description: Creates a default mock response for retrieving a policy.

methods.name: createPolicyResponseWithoutRead
methods.description: Creates a mock response representing a policy without read permissions.

methods.name: createPolicyResponseWithoutWrite
methods.description: Creates a mock response representing a policy without write permissions.

methods.name: createPolicyResponseWithoutReadOnEntries
methods.description: Creates a mock response with a policy that lacks read permissions specifically on entries.

methods.name: createPolicyResponseWithOnlyReadOnEntries
methods.description: Creates a mock response with a policy granting only read permission on entries.

methods.name: createPolicyResponseWithoutWriteOnEntries
methods.description: Creates a mock response with a policy that lacks write permissions specifically on entries.
